checks.description: The reference streetlight.json validates against streetlight-schema.json (cwi-streetlight/v1): format constant correct, all required keys present, vitals counts are integers-or-null (never fabricated), dates are YYYY-MM-DD, every signal carries observed date and source, methodology covers collection/aggregation/privacy/sampling.
The official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset. Brand rule: the logo ships on everything — no page renders without the logo badge.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.

EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (file, schema, card, announce, page, hub, contact) is live or correctly marked pending, and the APPLY block is a valid streetlight JSON skeleton.

evidence.brand-token-discipline: index.html header logo, announce.html header logo — logo.jpg on both shipped visual assets
evidence.give-block-operability: give-block.md EQUIP/CONFIGURE/APPLY reference streetlight.json, schema, item-card, announce, page, hub, hp@cumulativeweb.com; APPLY ships a schema-valid JSON skeleton with streetlight_published pointer
evidence.streetlight-schema-conformance: reference streetlight.json passes schema validation in automated gate 1 (required keys, format const, integer-or-null counts, YYYY-MM-DD dates, signal provenance, unattested nulls honest)
evidence.white-label-config: gate 4 builds a temp config.json override (orgName/productName/colors) through build.py and confirms the overrides land in index.html with no leftover tokens
